Manufacturer: Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools 7" Throttle Box Drywall Finishing Corner Box is designed to help professional drywall finishers quickly and consistently finish inside corners. Engineered for efficiency and control, the 7" Throttle Box delivers a smooth application of joint compound while helping produce clean, professional-looking inside corners.

Designed for use with professional drywall finishing systems, the Throttle Box helps streamline the corner-finishing process and reduce the time and effort required for manual finishing. Its 7" size provides an efficient working width for applying compound evenly along inside corners.

Consistent Corners. Faster Finishing.

Inside corners can be one of the most time-consuming parts of drywall finishing. The Columbia 7" Throttle Box is designed to make the process faster and more consistent by applying joint compound evenly as you work along the corner.

The result is a more efficient finishing process that helps professional crews maintain consistent results across the entire project.

Key Features

  • 7" Finishing Box – Designed specifically for finishing inside drywall corners.
  • Consistent Compound Application – Helps apply joint compound evenly along the corner for a uniform finish.
  • Throttle Control – Provides control over compound flow for more precise corner finishing.
  • Professional Corner Finishing – Designed to help create clean, consistent inside corners.
  • Improved Productivity – Helps reduce the time and effort required for manual corner finishing.
  • Easy to Control – Designed for smooth, controlled movement along inside corners.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built for the demands of daily drywall finishing.

The Columbia Taping Tools Gooseneck is designed to connect your Columbia Loading Pump to an automatic drywall taper, making it easy to quickly and efficiently fill the taper with joint compound.

Engineered specifically for professional drywall taping applications, the Gooseneck provides the connection and positioning needed to transfer compound from the loading pump directly into the taper. This simple but essential accessory helps streamline the loading process, keeping your taper ready to work and minimizing downtime on the jobsite.

Designed for Professional Tapers

The Gooseneck is an essential part of a professional drywall finishing setup. By allowing the loading pump to efficiently fill the taper, it eliminates unnecessary handling and helps keep the compound-loading process fast and consistent.

Whether you're working on a residential project or a large commercial job, the Columbia Gooseneck is built to help professional finishers maintain a smooth, productive workflow.

  • Designed for Taper Filling – Connects the Columbia Loading Pump to an automatic drywall taper for efficient compound loading.
  • Fast & Efficient Loading – Helps quickly fill your taper so you can spend more time taping and less time preparing.
  • Purpose-Built Design – Specifically designed for professional drywall taping and finishing applications.
  • Easy to Use – Provides a straightforward connection between the loading pump and taper.
  • Professional-Grade Construction – Built for the demands of daily drywall finishing.
  • Essential Jobsite Accessory – An important component for contractors using a loading pump and automatic taper.
  • Columbia Quality – Designed to work as part of the Columbia Taping Tools professional drywall finishing system.

Keep Your Taper Loaded and Your Job Moving

Efficient compound loading is critical to productivity. The Columbia Gooseneck makes it easy to transfer joint compound from your loading pump directly into your automatic taper, helping reduce interruptions and keep your production moving.

Connect. Fill. Tape. Repeat.

The Complete Introduction to Semi-Automatic Drywall Finishing

Ready to step up from traditional hand tools? The Columbia Taping Tools Commando Set takes the guesswork out of making the move to semi-automatic drywall tools. Designed as a complete introduction to semi-automatic finishing, the Commando Set is an excellent choice for part-time finishers, contractors looking to improve productivity, or professionals who want to experience the benefits of semi-automatic tools before making the move to a full automatic system.

The Commando Set includes the essential tools needed for applying and finishing drywall compound, including standard flushers, a compound mud tube, extendible and fixed handles, angle and flat applicator heads, a two-way internal corner applicator, and a corner roller head.

Semi-automatic tools help reduce repetitive hand work and can save valuable time on the job while delivering a consistent, professional finish. The combination of tools in the Commando Set gives you the versatility to tackle a wide range of drywall finishing applications with one complete system.

Everything comes packed in a convenient Semi-Automatic Case, making it easy to store, organize, protect, and transport your tools to and from the jobsite.

  • 2.5" Standard Flusher (2.5SF)

  • 42" Compound Mud Tube (CMT42)
  • Columbia One Extendible Handle 3'–5' (C1HEXT)
  • Columbia One Fixed Handle (C1H)
  • Angle Head Adapter (AHA)
  • Flat Applicator Head (CFLT)
  • Two-Way Internal Applicator (ICATW)
  • Corner Roller Head (CR)

Work Smarter. Finish Faster.

The Commando Set gives you the essential semi-automatic tools needed to increase productivity without requiring a complete transition to automatic equipment. By combining compound application, flat finishing, and corner finishing tools into one system, the Commando Set helps reduce repetitive work and makes it easier to achieve consistent results.

Whether you're a part-time finisher looking for a more efficient way to work or an experienced drywall professional ready to explore semi-automatic tools, the Columbia Commando Set provides a practical and versatile introduction to the Columbia semi-automatic system.

  • Ideal introduction to semi-automatic tools
  • Great for part-time finishers and professional contractors
  • Includes tools for flat joints, inside corners, and finishing applications
  • Helps reduce repetitive hand work and save time on the job

DTB: Description:
The Columbia Commando Set provides a comprehensive, semi-automatic solution for drywall finishers seeking to improve efficiency in corner finishing and compound application. Designed for those transitioning from manual methods to semi-automatic systems, this kit includes the essential tools required to streamline joint finishing workflows while maintaining consistent results.

Manufacturer: Description:
The Columbia Taping Tools ICATW Two-Way Internal Corner Applicator is designed to make applying drywall compound to inside corners faster, smoother, and more efficient. Its unique two-way design allows the applicator to travel in either direction along the corner, giving professional finishers greater flexibility and control without having to constantly reposition the tool.

Featuring a four-wheel configuration, the ICATW tracks smoothly along the wall while helping maintain consistent positioning and compound distribution throughout the corner. The precision-machined Delrin wheels provide a smooth glide, making it easier to achieve controlled, consistent application from one end of the corner to the other.

The ICATW is precision-machined from solid aluminum billet for the durability and accuracy required for professional drywall finishing. Designed to integrate with Columbia's semi-automatic compound application system, it pairs with a Columbia Compound Tube to efficiently deliver compound directly to internal corners.

Whether you're running vertical corners, horizontal angles, or working through high-volume production, the two-way design allows you to work efficiently in either direction while maintaining smooth compound application.

  • Four-wheel configuration for smooth, controlled movement

  • Designed for applying drywall compound to internal corners

  • Delrin wheels provide a smooth glide along drywall surfaces

  • Helps provide consistent compound distribution

  • Works with Columbia Compound Tubes

  • Reduces unnecessary repositioning while working corners

  • Handcrafted using high-quality U.S. aluminum and steel components

  • Machined in Columbia's state-of-the-art facility in Canada

  • Designed for professional drywall taping and finishing
